There's a lot of people already saying 'voice is the future' but I want to add my thoughts on why this is specifically interesting for us as a team:

IMO, one of the most interesting shifts happening in technology is the increasing share of voice as an interface. 

This isn't simply stuff like a customer support phone agent or those phone tree menus - it's the transition we're seeing from traditionally "non-audio" stuff being converted into voice/audio via AI. I mean - just think about the fact that we're now starting to "talk" to our computers. Not to mention all the completely new use cases still waiting to be discovered!

Our team saw this wave rise with the launch of audio in NotebookLM, especially with the way it was able to really occupy consumer mindshare. This tide is going to continue to rise, and it will really shift how we think about traditional (and new) interfaces.

As this shift happens, we believe voice quality and latency remain the top two most important features - and the team at Cartesia really understands this and is crushing it.

Super excited to see Sonic 3 launch - incredibly validating and cannot wait to see all the new audio experiences it will power!

nodes.author: ArtificialAnlys
nodes.text:
Cartesia has just released Sonic-3, their new flagship Text to Speech model for realtime conversation

Sonic-3 delivers Text to Speech streaming with built-in prosodic elements such as laughter, as well as emotions like surprise and curiosity. The new model supports 42 languages, including 9 Indian languages.

Sonic-3 leverages a State Space Model (SSM) architecture like Cartesia’s previous releases. Cartesia has been a leader in using SSMs, with other models typically using transformer-based architectures. SSMs are generally more compute and memory efficient, which likely contributes to Sonic-3’s comparatively impressive latency.

Cartesia offers a subscription and credits pricing model ranging from $0 per month for personal use, up to $299 per month for their Scale package.

Sonic-3 has been added to the Artificial Analysis Text to Speech Arena for blind preference voting.
